fusions.name: Rally the Herd
fusions.desc: A long throw that deals 26 damage, rising to 1.8 times that at full range. On a hit, every ally near you deals 15% more damage for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Ring of Horns
fusions.desc: Swings the haft around you, dealing 10 blunt damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocking each back 3 tiles. Its damage rises 10% for each ally near you, up to 40%.

fusions.name: Winter Pen
fusions.desc: Marks out a pen 4 tiles across where you stand. For 8 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and every ally inside it.

fusions.name: Calf at Your Heel
fusions.desc: A bonded grazen calf runs with you, butting enemies within 4 tiles for 3 damage every 1.4 seconds. Anything it butts moves 15% slower for 2 seconds.
